events.name: Tarawera Ultra-Trail by UTMB
events.gpxStatus: Official UTMB 2027 pages confirm five race courses and expose a Map + GPX tab on the individual T102 page. The tab is visible, but its underlying GPX download URL has not been extracted and the GPX binary has not been fetched. Official 2027 values: TMiler 163/3800, T102 102/2300 (aid station cumulative distance totals 101.9), T50 52/1150, T21 23/400, T14 14/161. No file is marked technically validated.
events.followUp: Extract Map + GPX download payloads for TMiler, T102, T50, T21 and T14; parse each file and compare computed distance/ascent with the official page before promoting it as 2027.

official2027CourseData.note: Official UTMB homepage and T102 race page show 102 km / 2,300 m+ and a Map + GPX tab. Aid-station table totals 101.9 km, which is a rounding/detail variation, not a reason to alter advertised distance. Third-party independently measured GPX figures may differ; organizer value is primary.

gpxTechnicalChecks.nextStep: Extract the actual Map + GPX tab payload or official download URLs from all five race pages, then retrieve and parse the GPX bytes. Keep any existing historic files unchanged.

events.retentionRule: Preserve older official GPX versions until new 2027 bytes are downloaded and validated. Do not overwrite or delete historical tracks.

events.gpxStatus: Official UTMB 2027 pages confirm five race routes and their advertised distances/elevation. The individual Hikuri 81K page is accessible; third-party independent route analysis reports measured route lengths differing slightly from organizer's rounded distances. This is a measurement distinction, not evidence of an outdated course. The official direct GPX bytes have not yet been obtained or parsed; do not mark any route technically validated.
events.followUp: Extract the actual Map + GPX downloads from all five Puerto Vallarta UTMB race pages and validate XML/trackpoints, measured distance and ascent; preserve any older GPX versions separately.

official2027CourseData.note: Official UTMB 2027 event and all five course values confirmed. Third-party route tracing reports mapped distances 80.2/53.1/37.2/20.3/4.9 km, while organizer advertises rounded 81/53/37/20/5 km. Keep organizer distances as advertised values; use parsed GPX only for separate measured fields.

gpxTechnicalChecks.note: Third-party measured trace lengths are useful only as a cross-check. They are not a substitute for fetching the official UTMB GPX file and independently parsing its trackpoints.

events.retentionRule: Do not overwrite or delete previous GPX versions. Add new official 2027 versions only after binary download and technical validation.
